cn.description:
432 Player plays the music you already own, retuned live from A = 440 Hz to A = 432 Hz. Nothing is converted or copied in advance: press play and hear your own songs in 432.

YOUR MUSIC, RETUNED AS IT PLAYS
• 432 Hz, or 528 mode (A = 444 Hz), switched while the song is playing
• Two ways to retune: Pitch shift keeps the song's speed; Song speed lowers pitch and tempo together, like a turntable
• Hold Compare to hear the original tuning and decide for yourself
• A test tone, so you can check the tuning with any tuner

A REAL MUSIC PLAYER
• Your Music library, the Files app, iCloud Drive and folders you link
• MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and more
• 10-band equalizer with presets and your own settings
• Playlists, Up Next, shuffle, repeat and search
• Lyrics from the song file or a matching .lrc file, in time with the retuned song
• Sleep timer, AirPlay, lock screen and headphone controls
• Designed for iPhone and iPad

INCLUDED: THE ALBUM DREAMWORLD
Twelve tracks by Ophir Paz come with the app, so there is something to play from the first minute. You can hide the album in Settings if you want only your own music.

FREE TO USE
Every feature is included for free. Free listening gives you 18 minutes of 432 or 528 Hz at a time. Then the tuning rests for one hour, and your music keeps playing at its original pitch.

432 PLAYER PRO
Pro removes the limit. One membership also unlocks 432 Player Radio, on iPhone and iPad.

ALREADY BOUGHT 432 PLAYER?
If you bought 432 Player before version 6, you keep full access for life. There is nothing you need to do.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Songs from an Apple Music subscription are protected and can't be retuned. Songs you own, bought or imported, play in 432.
• Most recorded music is tuned to A = 440 Hz, and that is what the app assumes.
• No account and no sign-in. Your music stays on your device.

PRIVACY
The app collects anonymous usage data and crash reports to help improve it. They are never linked to you and never used for advertising, and you can switch them off in Settings.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
432 Player Pro is offered as a monthly or a yearly subscription, and to new listeners as a one-time lifetime purchase for a limited time. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

mo.description:
432 Player plays the music you already own, retuned live from A = 440 Hz to A = 432 Hz. Nothing is converted or copied in advance: press play and hear your own songs in 432.

YOUR MUSIC, RETUNED AS IT PLAYS
• 432 Hz, or 528 mode (A = 444 Hz), switched while the song is playing
• Two ways to retune: Pitch shift keeps the song's speed; Song speed lowers pitch and tempo together, like a turntable
• Hold Compare to hear the original tuning and decide for yourself
• A test tone, so you can check the tuning with any tuner

A REAL MUSIC PLAYER
• Your Music library, the Files app, iCloud Drive and folders you link
• MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and more
• 10-band equalizer with presets and your own settings
• Playlists, Up Next, shuffle, repeat and search
• Lyrics from the song file or a matching .lrc file, in time with the retuned song
• Sleep timer, AirPlay, lock screen and headphone controls
• Designed for iPhone and iPad

INCLUDED: THE ALBUM DREAMWORLD
Twelve tracks by Ophir Paz come with the app, so there is something to play from the first minute. You can hide the album in Settings if you want only your own music.

FREE TO USE
Every feature is included for free. Free listening gives you 18 minutes of 432 or 528 Hz at a time. Then the tuning rests for one hour, and your music keeps playing at its original pitch.

432 PLAYER PRO
Pro removes the limit. One membership also unlocks 432 Player Radio, on iPhone and iPad.

ALREADY BOUGHT 432 PLAYER?
If you bought 432 Player before version 6, you keep full access for life. There is nothing you need to do.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Songs from an Apple Music subscription are protected and can't be retuned. Songs you own, bought or imported, play in 432.
• Most recorded music is tuned to A = 440 Hz, and that is what the app assumes.
• No account and no sign-in. Your music stays on your device.

PRIVACY
The app collects anonymous usage data and crash reports to help improve it. They are never linked to you and never used for advertising, and you can switch them off in Settings.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
432 Player Pro is offered as a monthly or a yearly subscription, and to new listeners as a one-time lifetime purchase for a limited time. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

mo.description:
Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride! 

Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. 

Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace. 

Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play!

Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard! 

Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic!


HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®:

Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). 
Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!
Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.
When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner! 


FEATURES
A TRULY SOCIAL TAKE ON MULTIPLAYER – Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session!
PLAY AROUND YOUR BUSY DAY – Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days.
SINGLE-PLAYER MODE DRIVEN BY EXPERT AIs – Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike. 
AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE – Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure. 
STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY – Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route.

Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

us.description:
Every enchantment is a gamble. Some of them make you stronger. Others, change the world completely.

Enchanted Survival is a survival roguelite. The weapons fire themselves, so the only thing you control is where you stand, and what you enchant and upgrade. Between waves the fighting stops and you walk to a lit shrine, feed it the crystals you picked up off the dead, and ask for an enchantment without being told what is coming.

Most enchantments improve an item. Then a pair of boots comes back with Frozenfoot, the lake you have been fighting beside freezes solid under your feet, and the half of the map you could never reach is the half you fight on for the rest of the run. 

Over 650 enchantments across lots of equipment. Pay for a deeper ritual and the rare results get likelier, and now and then two arrive at once. A clue tells you what the rite is leaning toward. 

KEEP WHAT YOU ROLLED, OR PUSH IT
Strengthen an enchantment through three tiers. Wager crystals at the anvil to temper a piece and raise its own number, then watch the bar run without knowing where it stops. Strip an enchantment out and free the socket. All of it is paid in the same crystals you could have spent on a fresh roll instead.

TEN LEVELS THAT EACH FIGHT BACK
A meadow built around a lake. A desert of pyramids and one oasis. Glacier basin, volcanic field, mushroom marsh, storm plateau, lighthouse coast, sunken ruins, crystal cavern. Some of them fall dark, and light turns into something you carry, place and stand near. 

THREE HEROES WHO PLAY DIFFERENTLY
The Adventurer, who starts the way the game was written. The Fisher, who swims open water instead of drowning in it and gets chased faster for the privilege. The Ranger, who opens with the bow and turns every ritual up a level.

CARRY ONE THING FORWARD
Clear a level and one worn item comes with you into every run after it. Finish a run and it pays out shards, which the stall at the head of the road turns into a second weapon, a better starting item, or a first ritual rolled a level deeper than you paid for.

FEATURES
- Over 650 enchantments, every one of them doing something you can see
- Enchant, strengthen, temper and strip, all on one currency
- Elites, minibosses and bosses that hold the wave until they fall
- Dark levels where light is something you have to bring
- A Codex and a bestiary that fill in as you go
- One thumb, landscape, built for a phone
- Eight languages
- Paid once. No ads, no in-app purchases, fully offline

tr.description:
432 Player plays the music you already own, retuned live from A = 440 Hz to A = 432 Hz. Nothing is converted or copied in advance: press play and hear your own songs in 432.

YOUR MUSIC, RETUNED AS IT PLAYS
• 432 Hz, or 528 mode (A = 444 Hz), switched while the song is playing
• Two ways to retune: Pitch shift keeps the song's speed; Song speed lowers pitch and tempo together, like a turntable
• Hold Compare to hear the original tuning and decide for yourself
• A test tone, so you can check the tuning with any tuner

A REAL MUSIC PLAYER
• Your Music library, the Files app, iCloud Drive and folders you link
• MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and more
• 10-band equalizer with presets and your own settings
• Playlists, Up Next, shuffle, repeat and search
• Lyrics from the song file or a matching .lrc file, in time with the retuned song
• Sleep timer, AirPlay, lock screen and headphone controls
• Designed for iPhone and iPad

INCLUDED: THE ALBUM DREAMWORLD
Twelve tracks by Ophir Paz come with the app, so there is something to play from the first minute. You can hide the album in Settings if you want only your own music.

FREE TO USE
Every feature is included for free. Free listening gives you 18 minutes of 432 or 528 Hz at a time. Then the tuning rests for one hour, and your music keeps playing at its original pitch.

432 PLAYER PRO
Pro removes the limit. One membership also unlocks 432 Player Radio, on iPhone and iPad.

ALREADY BOUGHT 432 PLAYER?
If you bought 432 Player before version 6, you keep full access for life. There is nothing you need to do.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Songs from an Apple Music subscription are protected and can't be retuned. Songs you own, bought or imported, play in 432.
• Most recorded music is tuned to A = 440 Hz, and that is what the app assumes.
• No account and no sign-in. Your music stays on your device.

PRIVACY
The app collects anonymous usage data and crash reports to help improve it. They are never linked to you and never used for advertising, and you can switch them off in Settings.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
432 Player Pro is offered as a monthly or a yearly subscription, and to new listeners as a one-time lifetime purchase for a limited time. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

pt.description:
Cada encantamento é uma aposta. A maioria torna você mais forte. Alguns mudam o mundo completamente.

Enchanted Survival é um roguelite de sobrevivência. As armas disparam sozinhas, então a única coisa que você controla é onde fica e o que encanta e aprimora. Entre as ondas a luta para e você caminha até um santuário iluminado, oferece a ele os cristais que recolheu dos mortos e pede um encantamento sem saber o que está por vir.

A maioria dos encantamentos melhora um item. Então um par de botas retorna com Pé Congelado, o lago ao lado do qual você lutava congela sob seus pés e a metade do mapa que você nunca conseguia alcançar passa a ser a metade onde você luta pelo resto da partida.

Mais de 650 encantamentos em uma variedade de equipamentos. Pague por um ritual mais profundo e os resultados raros ficam mais prováveis, e de vez em quando dois surgem de uma vez. Uma pista indica para o que o rito está se inclinando.

GUARDE O QUE CONSEGUIU, OU VÁ ALÉM
Fortaleça um encantamento ao longo de três níveis. Aposte cristais na bigorna para temperar uma peça e aumentar seu próprio número, depois observe a barra correr sem saber onde ela para. Remova um encantamento e libere o espaço. Tudo é pago com os mesmos cristais que você poderia ter gasto em uma nova tentativa.

DEZ NÍVEIS QUE REAGEM
Um prado construído ao redor de um lago. Um deserto de pirâmides e um oásis. Bacia glacial, campo vulcânico, pântano de cogumelos, planalto de tempestades, costa do farol, ruínas submersas, caverna de cristal. 432 Player plays the music you already own, retuned live from A = 440 Hz to A = 432 Hz. Nothing is converted or copied in advance: press play and hear your own songs in 432.

YOUR MUSIC, RETUNED AS IT PLAYS
• 432 Hz, or 528 mode (A = 444 Hz), switched while the song is playing
• Two ways to retune: Pitch shift keeps the song's speed; Song speed lowers pitch and tempo together, like a turntable
• Hold Compare to hear the original tuning and decide for yourself
• A test tone, so you can check the tuning with any tuner

A REAL MUSIC PLAYER
• Your Music library, the Files app, iCloud Drive and folders you link
• MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and more
• 10-band equalizer with presets and your own settings
• Playlists, Up Next, shuffle, repeat and search
• Lyrics from the song file or a matching .lrc file, in time with the retuned song
• Sleep timer, AirPlay, lock screen and headphone controls
• Designed for iPhone and iPad

INCLUDED: THE ALBUM DREAMWORLD
Twelve tracks by Ophir Paz come with the app, so there is something to play from the first minute. You can hide the album in Settings if you want only your own music.

FREE TO USE
Every feature is included for free. Free listening gives you 18 minutes of 432 or 528 Hz at a time. Then the tuning rests for one hour, and your music keeps playing at its original pitch.

432 PLAYER PRO
Pro removes the limit. One membership also unlocks 432 Player Radio, on iPhone and iPad.

ALREADY BOUGHT 432 PLAYER?
If you bought 432 Player before version 6, you keep full access for life. There is nothing you need to do.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Songs from an Apple Music subscription are protected and can't be retuned. Songs you own, bought or imported, play in 432.

PRIVACY
The app collects anonymous usage data and crash reports to help improve it. They are never linked to you and never used for advertising, and you can switch them off in Settings.
